plate_contract.framing: identical framing in both takes (make both from one start frame + its edit)
plate_contract.camera: identical slow dolly in both takes
seedance_lines: FORMAT: One continuous take; the attached image is the exact first frame.
CAMERA: the camera dollies very slowly straight forward at chest height, perfectly smooth and level, constant speed.
Nothing in the room moves or changes; FORBIDDEN: cuts, pans, tilts, shake, people, new objects.
POSITIVE LOCKS: no text, no logos, no signage, no UI, no captions at any time.
plate_contract.source: kling_plates/ba_before.mp4 + ba_after.mp4 (Kling 3.0 image_to_video from a text_to_image frame + its image_to_image 'before' edit)

styles.one: Premium logo sting: the mark draws on then fills silver, the wordmark opens from a light slit, a specular shine and star glint cross it with the plate's light.
styles.fonts: Michroma wordmark · Secular One tagline · JetBrains Mono
styles.prompt: Titles: LOGO-SHINE-REVEAL - logomark strokes draw then fill with brushed silver, wordmark opens from a light slit, specular shine + star glint in sync with the plate's light sweep, tagline settles, slow push-in.
styles.shoot_it_like_this: One take, no cuts · surface fills the frame; the centre clear and even · no free space needed

plate_contract.subject: a dark premium surface (brushed metal, stone, fabric) with one moving light
plate_contract.framing: surface fills the frame; the centre clear and even
plate_contract.camera: locked, imperceptible push-in
seedance_lines: FORMAT: One continuous shot, no cuts.
SUBJECT: a dark brushed-metal surface; a single soft light sweep glides slowly left to right, then settles into a soft glow.
CAMERA: locked-off with an imperceptible slow push-in, macro. FORBIDDEN: cuts, shake. Abstract surface only, no objects, no engraving.
POSITIVE LOCKS: no text, no logos, no signage, no UI, no captions at any time.

styles.one: Music-video kinetic lyrics in 3D: words fly in from depth on their sung syllables, key words behind the performer, parallax planes, magenta glow.
styles.fonts: Anton · Cormorant Garamond italic (Hebrew: Karantina · Suez One)
styles.sample: Kling · singer with native vocal · 10 s
styles.prompt: Titles: LYRIC-KINETIC-3D - words fly in from depth on the sung syllables, big condensed key words + small italic connectives, chosen words behind the performer (matte), counter-rotating planes, glow on the hook word.
styles.shoot_it_like_this: One take, no cuts · medium shot, performer centred, dark space above and on both sides · 18% free both sides · subject matte

plate_contract.subject: one performer singing (native vocal on the plate or the song as a ref), dark haze stage
plate_contract.framing: medium shot, performer centred, dark space above and on both sides
plate_contract.camera: very slow orbit
seedance_lines: FORMAT: One continuous shot, no cuts.
COMPOSITION: medium shot, the singer centred, large dark negative space with haze on both sides and above him.
CAMERA: very slow orbit, 50mm, shallow depth of field. FORBIDDEN: cuts, shake. Exactly one person.
POSITIVE LOCKS: no text, no logos, no signage, no UI, no captions at any time.

styles.one: History timeline: a ruled timeline with a travelling playhead, years count up as nodes pop, captions rise, sepia archival grade warms into colour at today.
styles.fonts: Suez One · Secular One (Latin: DM Serif Display · Manrope)
styles.prompt: Titles: TIMELINE-HISTORY - ruled timeline with minor ticks, travelling playhead, nodes pop and captions rise, big year odometer, sepia archival grade warming into colour at the present.
styles.shoot_it_like_this: One take, no cuts · the lower third calm enough for a timeline band; one open side for the big year · 30% free left

plate_contract.subject: a place or product with a history (old city, factory, building)
plate_contract.framing: the lower third calm enough for a timeline band; one open side for the big year
plate_contract.camera: slow steady glide
seedance_lines: FORMAT: One continuous shot, no cuts.
COMPOSITION: the subject in the right half; the lower third calm (water, ground, sky) for a timeline.

styles.one: Real-estate listing: status pill + title + address, tracked pins on the house, a glass spec bar with icons and count-ups, the asking price counting up.
styles.fonts: Suez One · Secular One (Latin: DM Serif Display · Manrope)
styles.prompt: Titles: LISTING-SPECS - status pill, property title and address, tracked pins with labels on the house, glass spec bar with line icons and count-up numbers, asking price counting up.
styles.shoot_it_like_this: One take, no cuts · the house centre-right; sky across the top quarter; calm ground across the bottom quarter · 30% free left

plate_contract.subject: a property exterior (or interior) approached slowly
plate_contract.framing: the house centre-right; sky across the top quarter; calm ground across the bottom quarter
plate_contract.camera: slow gimbal dolly, level
seedance_lines: FORMAT: One continuous shot, no cuts.
COMPOSITION: the house sits centre-right; clear sky across the top quarter and calm ground or water across the bottom quarter.
